# StepConfirm missing OPTION branch causes blank content
In 太仓一网通办H5, StepConfirm.vue only implements the MAINTAIN display branch and lacks an OPTION branch template, leaving the confirmation page content area blank.

## Root Cause
- src/views/owner-decision/components/StepConfirm.vue only implements the MAINTAIN display branch
- Lacks OPTION branch template; when decisionType==='OPTION' the content area is blank

## Fix
- Add selectedOptionItems computed property to read checked items in optionGroupList
- Render selected decision items when decisionType==='OPTION'

# OptionStepChoose wrong maxSelect reads decision-level optionNum
In 太仓一网通办H5, OptionStepChoose.vue's maxSelect prioritizes decision-level view.optionNum (total option count) instead of group-level currentGroup.optionNum (max selectable count), misjudging the limit as 4 and allowing over-selection.

## Root Cause
- OptionStepChoose.vue's maxSelect prioritizes decision-level view.optionNum (total option count)
- Does not use group-level currentGroup.optionNum (max selectable count), so limit misjudged as 4

## Fix
- Prioritize group-level optionNum and minOptionNum
- Add second validation on submit

# vote.js misreads waiver location causing empty abstention param
In 太仓一网通办H5, vote.js reads the waiver option from data.data.waiver (actually at top-level data.waiver), causing optionList to be empty.

## Root Cause
- vote.js fetchSelectView mistakenly read waiver from data.data.waiver after refactor
- Interface waiver option is actually at top-level data.waiver
- Caused optionList empty and missing abstention param

## Fix
- vote.js fetchSelectView uses detail.waiver || data.waiver to write voteWaiver
- OptionStepChoose.vue and election.ts sync the read logic

# ElectionCardList wrong detail style import causes unstyled stack
In 太仓一网通办H5, ElectionCardList.vue wrongly imports the detail page style @/views/decision/styles/card.css, which lacks .card-list layout classes, causing unstyled stacking.

## Root Cause
- ElectionCardList.vue wrongly imports detail page style @/views/decision/styles/card.css
- Lacks .card-list layout classes, causing cards to stack without styling

## Fix
- Add list container, horizontal image-text layout, and bottom alignment styles consistent with CardList.vue
